docs.title: О курсе
docs.text:
Этот курс посвящен изучению современных инструментов и технологий веб-разработки, включая:

  • FastAPI - современный веб-фреймворк для Python
  • SQLModel - библиотека для работы с базами данных
  • Alembic - система миграций для баз данных
  • Асинхронное программирование - threading, multiprocessing, asyncio
  • Парсинг веб-страниц - различные подходы к извлечению данных
  • LeetCode - решение алгоритмических задач

docs.text:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from .config import settings

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=15)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.secret_key, algorithm=settings.algorithm)
    return encoded_jwt

docs.text:
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from sqlmodel import Session, select
from .core.config import settings
from .core.security import verify_password
from .models.user import User
from .core.database import get_session

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="auth/login")

async def get_current_user(
    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),
    session: Session = Depends(get_session)
) -> User:
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[settings.algorithm])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception

    user = session.exec(select(User).where(User.username == username)).first()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user

async def get_current_active_user(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
    if not current_user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Inactive user")
    return current_user

docs.title: CRUD для книг (crud/book.py)
docs.text:
from sqlmodel import Session, select
from typing import List, Optional
from ..models.book import Book
from ..models.user import User

def create_book(session: Session, book: Book, owner: User) -> Book:
    book.owner_id = owner.id
    session.add(book)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(book)
    return book

def get_books(session: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100) -> List[Book]:
    return session.exec(select(Book).offset(skip).limit(limit)).all()

def get_book(session: Session, book_id: int) -> Optional[Book]:
    return session.get(Book, book_id)

def update_book(session: Session, book_id: int, book_update: Book) -> Optional[Book]:
    book = session.get(Book, book_id)
    if book:
        for key, value in book_update.dict(exclude_unset=True).items():
            setattr(book, key, value)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(book)
    return book

def delete_book(session: Session, book_id: int) -> bool:
    book = session.get(Book, book_id)
    if book:
        session.delete(book)
        session.commit()
        return True
    return False

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlmodel import Session, select
from typing import List
from connection import engine, create_db_and_tables, get_session
from models import Book, BookCreate, BookRead, BookUpdate

app = FastAPI()

# Создание таблиц при запуске
@app.on_event("startup")
def on_startup():
    create_db_and_tables()

@app.get("/")
def read_root():
    return {"message": "Book Exchange API with Database"}

@app.post("/books/", response_model=BookRead)
def create_book(book: BookCreate, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    db_book = Book.from_orm(book)
    session.add(db_book)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(db_book)
    return db_book

@app.get("/books/", response_model=List[BookRead])
def read_books(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    books = session.exec(select(Book).offset(skip).limit(limit)).all()
    return books

@app.get("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
def read_book(book_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    book = session.get(Book, book_id)
    if book is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")
    return book

@app.put("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
def update_book(book_id: int, book_update: BookUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    db_book = session.get(Book, book_id)
    if db_book is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")

    book_data = book_update.dict(exclude_unset=True)
    for key, value in book_data.items():
        setattr(db_book, key, value)

    session.add(db_book)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(db_book)
    return db_book

@app.delete("/books/{book_id}")
def delete_book(book_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    book = session.get(Book, book_id)
    if book is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")

    session.delete(book)
    session.commit()
    return {"message": "Book deleted successfully"}

from logging.config import fileConfig
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config
from sqlalchemy import pool
from alembic import context
from models import SQLModel

config = context.config

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = SQLModel.metadata

def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()

def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    connectable = engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata
        )

from sqlalchemy import create_engine

def get_migration_status():
    """Получение статуса миграций"""
    engine = create_engine("postgresql://...")

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        context = MigrationContext.configure(conn)
        current_rev = context.get_current_revision()

        script = ScriptDirectory.from_config(Config("alembic.ini"))
        head_rev = script.get_current_head()

        return {
            "current": current_rev,
            "head": head_rev,
            "behind": current_rev != head_rev
        }

def fetch_with_retry(url, max_retries=3):
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response.text
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"Error fetching {url}: {e}"
            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:
        future_to_url = {executor.submit(fetch_with_retry, url): url for url in urls}

        results = []
        for future in as_completed(future_to_url):
            url = future_to_url[future]
            try:
                result = future.result()
                results.append(result)
            except Exception as e:

import asyncio
import aiohttp
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
from typing import List, Dict
import logging

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class AsyncWebParser:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = 10):
        self.max_concurrent = max_concurrent
        self.semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)
        self.session = None

    async def __aenter__(self):
        self.session = aiohttp.ClientSession()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        if self.session:
            await self.session.close()

    async def fetch_page(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Асинхронная загрузка страницы"""
        async with self.semaphore:
            try:
                async with self.session.get(url, timeout=30) as response:
                    if response.status == 200:
                        return await response.text()
                    else:
                        logger.warning(f"HTTP {response.status} for {url}")
                        return ""
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
                return ""

    async def parse_page(self, url: str) -> Dict:
        """Парсинг одной страницы"""
        html = await self.fetch_page(url)
        if not html:
            return {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": "Failed to fetch"}

        try:
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

            # Извлечение заголовка
            title = soup.find('title')
            title_text = title.get_text().strip() if title else ""

            # Извлечение ссылок
            links = []
            for link in soup.find_all('a', href=True):
                href = link['href']
                text = link.get_text().strip()
                if href.startswith('http'):
                    links.append({"url": href, "text": text})

            return {
                "url": url,
                "title": title_text,
                "links": links,
                "links_count": len(links)
            }

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error parsing {url}: {e}")
            return {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": str(e)}

    async def parse_urls(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Парсинг списка URL"""
        logger.info(f"Starting async parsing of {len(urls)} URLs")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Создание задач для всех URL
        tasks = [self.parse_page(url) for url in urls]

        # Выполнение всех задач параллельно
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

        # Обработка результатов
        parsed_results = []
        for i, result in enumerate(results):
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Task {i} failed: {result}")
                parsed_results.append({
                    "url": urls[i],
                    "title": "",
                    "links": [],
                    "error": str(result)
                })
            else:
                parsed_results.append(result)

        end_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"Async parsing completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

        return parsed_results

async def main():
    # Список URL для парсинга
    urls = [
        "https://httpbin.org/html",
        "https://httpbin.org/json",
        "https://httpbin.org/xml",
        "https://httpbin.org/robots.txt",
        "https://httpbin.org/user-agent",
        "https://httpbin.org/headers",
        "https://httpbin.org/ip",
        "https://httpbin.org/uuid",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/1",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/2"
    ]

    # Создание и использование парсера
    async with AsyncWebParser(max_concurrent=5) as parser:
        results = await parser.parse_urls(urls)

        # Вывод результатов
        for result in results:
            print(f"URL: {result['url']}")
            print(f"Title: {result['title']}")
            print(f"Links: {result['links_count']}")
            if 'error' in result:
                print(f"Error: {result['error']}")
            print("-" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import threading
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
from typing import List, Dict
import logging
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from queue import Queue
import json

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class ThreadingWebParser:
    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = 10):
        self.max_workers = max_workers
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.results_queue = Queue()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def fetch_page(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Загрузка страницы в отдельном потоке"""
        try:
            response = self.session.get(url, timeout=30)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response.text
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
            return ""

    def parse_page(self, url: str) -> Dict:
        """Парсинг одной страницы"""
        html = self.fetch_page(url)
        if not html:
            return {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": "Failed to fetch"}

        try:
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

            # Извлечение заголовка
            title = soup.find('title')
            title_text = title.get_text().strip() if title else ""

            # Извлечение ссылок
            links = []
            for link in soup.find_all('a', href=True):
                href = link['href']
                text = link.get_text().strip()
                if href.startswith('http'):
                    links.append({"url": href, "text": text})

            result = {
                "url": url,
                "title": title_text,
                "links": links,
                "links_count": len(links)
            }

            # Потокобезопасное добавление результата
            with self.lock:
                self.results_queue.put(result)

            return result

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error parsing {url}: {e}")
            error_result = {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": str(e)}
            with self.lock:
                self.results_queue.put(error_result)
            return error_result

    def parse_urls(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Парсинг списка URL с использованием пула потоков"""
        logger.info(f"Starting threading parsing of {len(urls)} URLs")
        start_time = time.time()

        results = []

        # Использование ThreadPoolExecutor для управления потоками
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.max_workers) as executor:
            # Отправка задач в пул
            future_to_url = {
                executor.submit(self.parse_page, url): url 
                for url in urls
            }

            # Сбор результатов по мере завершения
            for future in as_completed(future_to_url):
                url = future_to_url[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                    results.append(result)
                    logger.info(f"Completed parsing {url}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Task for {url} generated an exception: {e}")
                    results.append({
                        "url": url,
                        "title": "",
                        "links": [],
                        "error": str(e)
                    })

        end_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"Threading parsing completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

        return results

    def parse_urls_with_queue(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Альтернативная реализация с использованием очереди"""
        logger.info(f"Starting queue-based parsing of {len(urls)} URLs")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Очистка очереди
        while not self.results_queue.empty():
            self.results_queue.get()

        # Создание и запуск потоков
        threads = []
        for url in urls:
            thread = threading.Thread(target=self.parse_page, args=(url,))
            threads.append(thread)
            thread.start()

        # Ожидание завершения всех потоков
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()

        # Сбор результатов из очереди
        results = []
        while not self.results_queue.empty():
            results.append(self.results_queue.get())

        end_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"Queue-based parsing completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

        return results

def main():
    # Список URL для парсинга
    urls = [
        "https://httpbin.org/html",
        "https://httpbin.org/json",
        "https://httpbin.org/xml",
        "https://httpbin.org/robots.txt",
        "https://httpbin.org/user-agent",
        "https://httpbin.org/headers",
        "https://httpbin.org/ip",
        "https://httpbin.org/uuid",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/1",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/2"
    ]

    # Создание парсера
    parser = ThreadingWebParser(max_workers=5)

    # Парсинг с использованием ThreadPoolExecutor
    results = parser.parse_urls(urls)

    # Вывод результатов
    for result in results:
        print(f"URL: {result['url']}")
        print(f"Title: {result['title']}")
        print(f"Links: {result['links_count']}")
        if 'error' in result:
            print(f"Error: {result['error']}")
        print("-" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import multiprocessing
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
from typing import List, Dict
import logging
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import json
import os

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def fetch_page(url: str) -> str:
    """Загрузка страницы в отдельном процессе"""
    try:
        session = requests.Session()
        response = session.get(url, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.text
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
        return ""

def parse_page(url: str) -> Dict:
    """Парсинг одной страницы в отдельном процессе"""
    html = fetch_page(url)
    if not html:
        return {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": "Failed to fetch"}

    try:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

        # Извлечение заголовка
        title = soup.find('title')
        title_text = title.get_text().strip() if title else ""

        # Извлечение ссылок
        links = []
        for link in soup.find_all('a', href=True):
            href = link['href']
            text = link.get_text().strip()
            if href.startswith('http'):
                links.append({"url": href, "text": text})

        return {
            "url": url,
            "title": title_text,
            "links": links,
            "links_count": len(links),
            "process_id": os.getpid()
        }

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error parsing {url}: {e}")
        return {"url": url, "title": "", "links": [], "error": str(e), "process_id": os.getpid()}

class MultiprocessingWebParser:
    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = None):
        self.max_workers = max_workers or min(32, os.cpu_count() + 4)

    def parse_urls(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Парсинг списка URL с использованием пула процессов"""
        logger.info(f"Starting multiprocessing parsing of {len(urls)} URLs")
        logger.info(f"Using {self.max_workers} processes")
        start_time = time.time()

        results = []

        # Использование ProcessPoolExecutor для управления процессами
        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.max_workers) as executor:
            # Отправка задач в пул
            future_to_url = {
                executor.submit(parse_page, url): url 
                for url in urls
            }

            # Сбор результатов по мере завершения
            for future in as_completed(future_to_url):
                url = future_to_url[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                    results.append(result)
                    logger.info(f"Completed parsing {url} in process {result.get('process_id', 'unknown')}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Task for {url} generated an exception: {e}")
                    results.append({
                        "url": url,
                        "title": "",
                        "links": [],
                        "error": str(e)
                    })

        end_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"Multiprocessing parsing completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

        return results

    def parse_urls_chunked(self, urls: List[str], chunk_size: int = 5) -> List[Dict]:
        """Парсинг URL блоками для лучшего контроля памяти"""
        logger.info(f"Starting chunked parsing of {len(urls)} URLs")
        start_time = time.time()

        all_results = []

        # Разделение URL на блоки
        url_chunks = [urls[i:i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(urls), chunk_size)]

        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.max_workers) as executor:
            for chunk in url_chunks:
                logger.info(f"Processing chunk of {len(chunk)} URLs")

                # Отправка блока задач
                future_to_url = {
                    executor.submit(parse_page, url): url 
                    for url in chunk
                }

                # Сбор результатов блока
                chunk_results = []
                for future in as_completed(future_to_url):
                    url = future_to_url[future]
                    try:
                        result = future.result()
                        chunk_results.append(result)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Task for {url} generated an exception: {e}")
                        chunk_results.append({
                            "url": url,
                            "title": "",
                            "links": [],
                            "error": str(e)
                        })

                all_results.extend(chunk_results)

        end_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"Chunked parsing completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

        return all_results

def parse_urls_batch(urls_batch: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
    """Функция для пакетной обработки URL"""
    results = []
    for url in urls_batch:
        result = parse_page(url)
        results.append(result)
    return results

def main():
    # Список URL для парсинга
    urls = [
        "https://httpbin.org/html",
        "https://httpbin.org/json",
        "https://httpbin.org/xml",
        "https://httpbin.org/robots.txt",
        "https://httpbin.org/user-agent",
        "https://httpbin.org/headers",
        "https://httpbin.org/ip",
        "https://httpbin.org/uuid",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/1",
        "https://httpbin.org/delay/2"
    ]

    # Создание парсера
    parser = MultiprocessingWebParser(max_workers=4)

    # Парсинг с использованием ProcessPoolExecutor
    results = parser.parse_urls(urls)

    # Вывод результатов
    for result in results:
        print(f"URL: {result['url']}")
        print(f"Title: {result['title']}")
        print(f"Links: {result['links_count']}")
        print(f"Process ID: {result.get('process_id', 'N/A')}")
        if 'error' in result:
            print(f"Error: {result['error']}")
        print("-" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Важно для multiprocessing на Windows
    multiprocessing.freeze_support()
    main()

import time

import os

# Импорт парсеров
from async_parser import AsyncWebParser
from threading_parser import ThreadingWebParser
from multiprocessing_parser import MultiprocessingWebParser

def measure_performance(parser_func, urls: List[str], name: str) -> Dict:
    """Измерение производительности парсера"""
    print(f"\nТестирование {name}...")

    # Измерение времени
    start_time = time.time()
    start_memory = psutil.Process().memory_info().rss / 1024 / 1024  # MB

    # Выполнение парсинга
    if name == "Async":
        results = asyncio.run(parser_func(urls))
    else:
        results = parser_func(urls)

    end_time = time.time()
    end_memory = psutil.Process().memory_info().rss / 1024 / 1024  # MB

    execution_time = end_time - start_time
    memory_usage = end_memory - start_memory

    # Статистика результатов
    successful = sum(1 for r in results if 'error' not in r)
    failed = len(results) - successful

    return {
        "name": name,
        "execution_time": execution_time,
        "memory_usage": memory_usage,
        "successful": successful,
        "failed": failed,
        "total": len(results),
        "urls_per_second": len(urls) / execution_time
    }

def run_performance_test():
    """Запуск теста производительности"""
    # Список URL для тестирования
    urls = [
        "https://httpbin.org/html",
        "https://httpbin.org/json",

            return await parser.parse_urls(urls)

    def threading_parser(urls):
        parser = ThreadingWebParser(max_workers=5)
        return parser.parse_urls(urls)

    def multiprocessing_parser(urls):
        parser = MultiprocessingWebParser(max_workers=4)
        return parser.parse_urls(urls)

    # Тестирование всех подходов
    results = []

    results.append(measure_performance(async_parser, urls, "Async"))
    results.append(measure_performance(threading_parser, urls, "Threading"))
    results.append(measure_performance(multiprocessing_parser, urls, "Multiprocessing"))

    # Вывод результатов

import asyncio
import time
from functools import wraps

def async_retry(max_retries=3, delay=1):
    """Декоратор для повторных попыток в asyncio"""
    def decorator(func):
        @wraps(func)
        async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            last_exception = None
            for attempt in range(max_retries):
                try:
                    return await func(*args, **kwargs)
                except Exception as e:
                    last_exception = e
                    if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        await asyncio.sleep(delay * (2 ** attempt))
            raise last_exception
        return wrapper
    return decorator

def sync_retry(max_retries=3, delay=1):
    """Декоратор для повторных попыток в синхронном коде"""
    def decorator(func):
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            last_exception = None
            for attempt in range(max_retries):
                try:
                    return func(*args, **kwargs)
                except Exception as e:
                    last_exception = e
                    if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        time.sleep(delay * (2 ** attempt))
            raise last_exception
        return wrapper
    return decorator

import asyncio
import time
import random
from typing import List, Tuple
import logging

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class AsyncSumCalculator:
    def __init__(self, chunk_size: int = 10000):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size

    def generate_data(self, size: int) -> List[int]:
        """Генерация тестовых данных"""
        logger.info(f"Generating {size} random numbers...")
        return [random.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(size)]

    def split_data(self, data: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        """Разделение данных на блоки"""
        chunks = []
        for i in range(0, len(data), self.chunk_size):
            chunk = data[i:i + self.chunk_size]
            chunks.append(chunk)
        logger.info(f"Split data into {len(chunks)} chunks")
        return chunks

    async def calculate_chunk_sum(self, chunk: List[int], chunk_id: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """Асинхронный подсчет суммы для одного блока"""
        logger.info(f"Starting calculation for chunk {chunk_id} with {len(chunk)} elements")

        # Имитация CPU-интенсивной работы
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

        # Подсчет суммы
        chunk_sum = sum(chunk)

        logger.info(f"Chunk {chunk_id} completed: sum = {chunk_sum}")
        return chunk_id, chunk_sum

    async def calculate_sum_async(self, data: List[int]) -> int:
        """Асинхронный подсчет общей суммы"""
        logger.info(f"Starting async sum calculation for {len(data)} elements")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = self.split_data(data)

        # Создание задач для всех блоков
        tasks = [
            self.calculate_chunk_sum(chunk, i) 
            for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)
        ]

        # Выполнение всех задач параллельно
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Async calculation completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

    async def calculate_sum_with_semaphore(self, data: List[int], max_concurrent: int = 4) -> int:
        """Асинхронный подсчет с ограничением конкурентности"""
        logger.info(f"Starting async sum calculation with semaphore for {len(data)} elements")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Создание семафора для ограничения конкурентности
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)

        async def calculate_chunk_with_semaphore(chunk: List[int], chunk_id: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
            async with semaphore:
                return await self.calculate_chunk_sum(chunk, chunk_id)

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = self.split_data(data)

        # Создание задач с семафором
        tasks = [
            calculate_chunk_with_semaphore(chunk, i) 
            for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)
        ]

        # Выполнение задач
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Async calculation with semaphore completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

async def main():
    # Создание калькулятора
    calculator = AsyncSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)

    # Генерация тестовых данных
    data_size = 1000000  # 1 миллион элементов

import threading
import time
import random
from typing import List, Tuple
import logging
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from queue import Queue

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class ThreadingSumCalculator:
    def __init__(self, chunk_size: int = 10000):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.results_queue = Queue()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def generate_data(self, size: int) -> List[int]:
        """Генерация тестовых данных"""
        logger.info(f"Generating {size} random numbers...")
        return [random.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(size)]

    def split_data(self, data: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        """Разделение данных на блоки"""
        chunks = []
        for i in range(0, len(data), self.chunk_size):
            chunk = data[i:i + self.chunk_size]
            chunks.append(chunk)
        logger.info(f"Split data into {len(chunks)} chunks")
        return chunks

    def calculate_chunk_sum(self, chunk: List[int], chunk_id: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """Подсчет суммы для одного блока в отдельном потоке"""
        logger.info(f"Starting calculation for chunk {chunk_id} with {len(chunk)} elements")

        # Имитация CPU-интенсивной работы
        time.sleep(0.1)

        # Подсчет суммы
        chunk_sum = sum(chunk)

        logger.info(f"Chunk {chunk_id} completed: sum = {chunk_sum}")
        return chunk_id, chunk_sum

    def calculate_sum_threading(self, data: List[int], max_workers: int = 4) -> int:
        """Многопоточный подсчет общей суммы"""
        logger.info(f"Starting threading sum calculation for {len(data)} elements")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = self.split_data(data)

        results = []

        # Использование ThreadPoolExecutor
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
            # Отправка задач в пул
            future_to_chunk = {
                executor.submit(self.calculate_chunk_sum, chunk, i): i 
                for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)
            }

            # Сбор результатов по мере завершения
            for future in as_completed(future_to_chunk):
                chunk_id = future_to_chunk[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                    results.append(result)
                    logger.info(f"Completed chunk {chunk_id}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Chunk {chunk_id} generated an exception: {e}")

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Threading calculation completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

    def calculate_sum_with_queue(self, data: List[int]) -> int:
        """Альтернативная реализация с использованием очереди"""
        logger.info(f"Starting queue-based sum calculation for {len(data)} elements")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Очистка очереди
        while not self.results_queue.empty():
            self.results_queue.get()

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = self.split_data(data)

        # Создание и запуск потоков
        threads = []
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
            thread = threading.Thread(
                target=self._calculate_chunk_with_queue, 
                args=(chunk, i)
            )
            threads.append(thread)
            thread.start()

        # Ожидание завершения всех потоков
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()

        # Сбор результатов из очереди
        results = []
        while not self.results_queue.empty():
            results.append(self.results_queue.get())

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Queue-based calculation completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

    def _calculate_chunk_with_queue(self, chunk: List[int], chunk_id: int):
        """Вспомогательная функция для работы с очередью"""
        result = self.calculate_chunk_sum(chunk, chunk_id)
        with self.lock:
            self.results_queue.put(result)

def main():
    # Создание калькулятора
    calculator = ThreadingSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)

    # Генерация тестовых данных
    data_size = 1000000  # 1 миллион элементов
    data = calculator.generate_data(data_size)

    print(f"Generated {len(data)} random numbers")
    print(f"Expected sum (approximate): {len(data) * 500}")  # Среднее значение 500

    # Тестирование многопоточного подсчета
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("THREADING CALCULATION")
    print("="*50)

    result1 = calculator.calculate_sum_threading(data, max_workers=4)

    # Тестирование подсчета с очередью
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("QUEUE-BASED CALCULATION")
    print("="*50)

    result2 = calculator.calculate_sum_with_queue(data)

    # Проверка результатов
    print(f"\nResults match: {result1 == result2}")
    print(f"Final sum: {result1}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import time
import random
from typing import List, Tuple
import logging
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import os

# Настройка логирования
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def generate_data(size: int) -> List[int]:
    """Генерация тестовых данных"""
    logger.info(f"Generating {size} random numbers...")
    return [random.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(size)]

def split_data(data: List[int], chunk_size: int) -> List[List[int]]:
    """Разделение данных на блоки"""
    chunks = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), chunk_size):
        chunk = data[i:i + chunk_size]
        chunks.append(chunk)
    logger.info(f"Split data into {len(chunks)} chunks")
    return chunks

def calculate_chunk_sum(chunk_data: Tuple[List[int], int]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    """Подсчет суммы для одного блока в отдельном процессе"""
    chunk, chunk_id = chunk_data

    logger.info(f"Starting calculation for chunk {chunk_id} with {len(chunk)} elements in process {os.getpid()}")

    # Имитация CPU-интенсивной работы
    time.sleep(0.1)

    # Подсчет суммы
    chunk_sum = sum(chunk)

    logger.info(f"Chunk {chunk_id} completed: sum = {chunk_sum} in process {os.getpid()}")
    return chunk_id, chunk_sum

class MultiprocessingSumCalculator:
    def __init__(self, chunk_size: int = 10000):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size

    def calculate_sum_multiprocessing(self, data: List[int], max_workers: int = None) -> int:
        """Многопроцессный подсчет общей суммы"""
        if max_workers is None:
            max_workers = min(32, os.cpu_count() + 4)

        logger.info(f"Starting multiprocessing sum calculation for {len(data)} elements")
        logger.info(f"Using {max_workers} processes")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = split_data(data, self.chunk_size)

        # Подготовка данных для процессов
        chunk_data = [(chunk, i) for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)]

        results = []

        # Использование ProcessPoolExecutor
        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
            # Отправка задач в пул
            future_to_chunk = {
                executor.submit(calculate_chunk_sum, chunk_data_item): i 
                for i, chunk_data_item in enumerate(chunk_data)
            }

            # Сбор результатов по мере завершения
            for future in as_completed(future_to_chunk):
                chunk_id = future_to_chunk[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                    results.append(result)
                    logger.info(f"Completed chunk {chunk_id}")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Chunk {chunk_id} generated an exception: {e}")

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Multiprocessing calculation completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

    def calculate_sum_chunked(self, data: List[int], chunk_size: int = 5, max_workers: int = None) -> int:
        """Многопроцессный подсчет блоками для лучшего контроля памяти"""
        if max_workers is None:
            max_workers = min(32, os.cpu_count() + 4)

        logger.info(f"Starting chunked multiprocessing calculation for {len(data)} elements")
        start_time = time.time()

        # Разделение данных на блоки
        chunks = split_data(data, self.chunk_size)

        # Разделение блоков на группы
        chunk_groups = [chunks[i:i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(chunks), chunk_size)]

        all_results = []

        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
            for group_id, chunk_group in enumerate(chunk_groups):
                logger.info(f"Processing group {group_id} with {len(chunk_group)} chunks")

                # Подготовка данных для группы
                group_data = [(chunk, i) for i, chunk in enumerate(chunk_group)]

                # Отправка группы задач
                future_to_chunk = {
                    executor.submit(calculate_chunk_sum, chunk_data_item): i 
                    for i, chunk_data_item in enumerate(group_data)
                }

                # Сбор результатов группы
                group_results = []
                for future in as_completed(future_to_chunk):
                    chunk_id = future_to_chunk[future]
                    try:
                        result = future.result()
                        group_results.append(result)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Chunk {chunk_id} generated an exception: {e}")

                all_results.extend(group_results)

        # Подсчет общей суммы
        total_sum = sum(chunk_sum for _, chunk_sum in all_results)

        end_time = time.time()
        execution_time = end_time - start_time

        logger.info(f"Chunked multiprocessing calculation completed in {execution_time:.2f} seconds")
        logger.info(f"Total sum: {total_sum}")

        return total_sum

def calculate_sum_batch(chunk_batch: List[Tuple[List[int], int]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    """Функция для пакетной обработки блоков"""
    results = []
    for chunk_data in chunk_batch:
        result = calculate_chunk_sum(chunk_data)
        results.append(result)
    return results

def main():
    # Создание калькулятора
    calculator = MultiprocessingSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)

    # Генерация тестовых данных
    data_size = 1000000  # 1 миллион элементов
    data = generate_data(data_size)

    print(f"Generated {len(data)} random numbers")
    print(f"Expected sum (approximate): {len(data) * 500}")  # Среднее значение 500

    # Тестирование многопроцессного подсчета
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("MULTIPROCESSING CALCULATION")
    print("="*50)

    result1 = calculator.calculate_sum_multiprocessing(data, max_workers=4)

    # Тестирование блочного подсчета
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("CHUNKED MULTIPROCESSING CALCULATION")
    print("="*50)

    result2 = calculator.calculate_sum_chunked(data, chunk_size=3, max_workers=4)

    # Проверка результатов
    print(f"\nResults match: {result1 == result2}")
    print(f"Final sum: {result1}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Важно для multiprocessing на Windows

import time

from typing import List, Dict
import psutil

# Импорт калькуляторов
from sum_count_async import AsyncSumCalculator
from sum_count_threading import ThreadingSumCalculator
from sum_count_multiprocessing import MultiprocessingSumCalculator, generate_data

def measure_performance(calculator_func, data: List[int], name: str) -> Dict:
    """Измерение производительности калькулятора"""
    print(f"\nТестирование {name}...")

    # Измерение времени
    start_time = time.time()
    start_memory = psutil.Process().memory_info().rss / 1024 / 1024  # MB

    # Выполнение подсчета
    if name == "Async":
        result = asyncio.run(calculator_func(data))
    else:
        result = calculator_func(data)

    end_time = time.time()
    end_memory = psutil.Process().memory_info().rss / 1024 / 1024  # MB

    execution_time = end_time - start_time
    memory_usage = end_memory - start_memory

    return {
        "name": name,
        "execution_time": execution_time,
        "memory_usage": memory_usage,
        "result": result,
        "elements_per_second": len(data) / execution_time
    }

def run_performance_test():
    """Запуск теста производительности"""
    # Генерация тестовых данных
    data_size = 1000000  # 1 миллион элементов
    data = generate_data(data_size)

    print(f"Generated {len(data)} random numbers for testing")

    # Функции калькуляторов
    async def async_calculator(data):
        calculator = AsyncSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)
        return await calculator.calculate_sum_async(data)

    def threading_calculator(data):
        calculator = ThreadingSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)
        return calculator.calculate_sum_threading(data, max_workers=4)

    def multiprocessing_calculator(data):
        calculator = MultiprocessingSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)
        return calculator.calculate_sum_multiprocessing(data, max_workers=4)

    # Тестирование всех подходов
    results = []

    results.append(measure_performance(async_calculator, data, "Async"))
    results.append(measure_performance(threading_calculator, data, "Threading"))
    results.append(measure_performance(multiprocessing_calculator, data, "Multiprocessing"))

    # Вывод результатов
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("РЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ ТЕСТИРОВАНИЯ ПРОИЗВОДИТЕЛЬНОСТИ")
    print("="*60)

    for result in results:
        print(f"\n{result['name']}:")
        print(f"  Время выполнения: {result['execution_time']:.2f} сек")
        print(f"  Использование памяти: {result['memory_usage']:.2f} MB")
        print(f"  Результат: {result['result']}")
        print(f"  Элементов в секунду: {result['elements_per_second']:.0f}")

    # Сравнение
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("СРАВНЕНИЕ")
    print("="*60)

    fastest = min(results, key=lambda x: x['execution_time'])
    most_efficient = min(results, key=lambda x: x['memory_usage'])

    print(f"Самый быстрый: {fastest['name']} ({fastest['execution_time']:.2f} сек)")
    print(f"Самый экономичный по памяти: {most_efficient['name']} ({most_efficient['memory_usage']:.2f} MB)")

    # Проверка корректности
    results_match = all(r['result'] == results[0]['result'] for r in results)
    print(f"Результаты совпадают: {results_match}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_performance_test()

def calculate_chunk_sum_safe(chunk_data: Tuple[List[int], int]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    """Безопасный подсчет суммы с обработкой ошибок"""
    try:
        chunk, chunk_id = chunk_data

        logger.info(f"Processing chunk {chunk_id} in process {os.getpid()}")

        # Проверка входных данных
        if not chunk:
            logger.warning(f"Empty chunk {chunk_id}")
            return chunk_id, 0

        # Подсчет суммы
        chunk_sum = sum(chunk)

        logger.info(f"Chunk {chunk_id} completed successfully")
        return chunk_id, chunk_sum

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error processing chunk {chunk_id}: {e}")
        return chunk_id, 0

def calculate_sum_with_retry(data: List[int], max_retries: int = 3) -> int:
    """Подсчет суммы с повторными попытками"""
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            calculator = MultiprocessingSumCalculator(chunk_size=50000)
            return calculator.calculate_sum_multiprocessing(data, max_workers=4)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Attempt {attempt + 1} failed: {e}")
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)  # Экспоненциальная задержка
